entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • TapGestureRecognizer cannot be tapped using Android Talkback in MAUI 9.0.100 #31483
  • Editor unable to select text programatically #31481
  • RightToLeft does not apply for FormattedText #31480

Closed

  • [Testing] Write a test that would have accounted for "Expose DispatcherExtentions" #31185
    .NET 10.0-rc2

    .NET 10.0-rc2
